onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first scanner trigger pulse.

trial_type.Description: Type of stimulus presented during the trial.

task_condition.Description: Working-memory condition of the nBack task. 2-back for all trials.

block_num.Description: Sequential block number within the nBack task.

target.Description: Indicates whether the current image is the same as the one two trials before (target, ~10%) or different (nontarget, ~90%).

Levels.target: The current image is the same as the one presented two trials previously.
Levels.nontarget: The current image is different from the one presented two trials previously.

face_num.Description: Identifier of the face stimulus presented on the trial. n/a on scene trials.

scene_num.Description: Identifier of the scene stimulus presented on the trial. n/a on face trials.

response_time.Description: Response time measured from stimulus onset to the participant's response. n/a if no response was made.

key_pressed.Description: Response key recorded for the participant's response.

Levels.B: The assigned response key was pressed.
Levels.R: A key other than the assigned response key was pressed. Decoded as R via it's raw ASCII code.
Levels.Y: A key other than the assigned response key was pressed. Decoded as Y via it's raw ASCII code.
Levels.G: A key other than the assigned response key was pressed. Decoded as G via it's raw ASCII code.
Levels.multipress(B,other_button): B and another button were both pressed.

correct_key.Description: Correct response key for the trial. B if a press was required (nontarget); n/a if withholding was required (target).

accuracy.Description: Indicates whether the participant's response was correct.

trial_num.Description: Sequential trial number within the nBack task.
